en.podcast_title: Episode 01: What Makes the Four Seasons George V Paris Worth $2,000 a Night?
en.soundscape_description: Soft violin strains echo through the soaring marble lobby, harmonizing seamlessly with 1950s French jazz streaming from the suite's Bang & Olufsen sound system.
en.gastronomy_title: The 3-Michelin-Starred Pinnacle of Le Cinq & a 50,000-Bottle Cellar
en.gastronomy_dish: Flaky croissants infused with rich Isigny butter enjoyed on your private balcony, paired with Chef Christian Le Squer’s legendary Soupe à l'Oignon Gratinée.
en.wine_pairing: Dom Pérignon Vintage Champagne in a historic wine cellar subterraneanly carved 14 meters below Paris
en.positive_emotion: A profound sense of quiet power—escaping the mundane to surrender to authentic regal pampering in the heart of Paris.
en.client_concern: Concerns over Paris's urban hustle are effortlessly dissipated by triple-glazed acoustic insulation and a discreet VIP passageway away from public gaze.
en.target_persona: Global leaders, statesmen, and discerning couples marking milestones, seeking an unforgettable chapter of immortalized luxury.
en.woa_declaration: THIS IS A MUST-VISIT DESTINATION OF A LIFETIME—A SANCTUARY TO RETURN TO EVERY YEAR TO RE-EXPERIENCE TRUE ROYALTY.
en.victor_note: As the revolving door on Avenue George V turns, the fragrance of 12,000 fresh blooms curated by floral artist Jeff Leatham instantly suspends time. Descending 14 meters into the historic 50,000-bottle wine cellar alongside Head Sommelier Eric Beaumard is a poignant reminder of why French elegance remains unrivaled globally.
en.lucky_note: The most exquisite secret here: awaken at 6:45 AM, part the heavy silk drapes of your Balcony Suite, and watch the golden dawn bathe the Eiffel Tower. Booking via our Expedia partner network unlocks seamless room upgrades, delivered with the utmost reverence.
critique_positives: A network of concierges and butlers holding keys to closed-door museum viewings
Chef Christian Le Squer’s 3-Michelin-starred culinary cathedral, Le Cinq
Impeccable acoustic engineering—absolute serenity soaring three stories above the vibrant Golden Triangle
critique_considerations: Suites facing Avenue George V may catch distant motorcade sirens during Fashion Week; request a courtyard-facing suite if you are particularly sound-sensitive
In-suite balcony breakfast service requires 45 minutes advance notice to ensure exquisite silver-tray and crisp linen presentation

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor, why would someone willingly part with $2,000 for a single night at George V? Is it merely the royal branding?

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Not at all, Lucky. At George V, they don't sell a sumptuous bed; they curate the sensibility of 19th-century French nobility. As you enter the grand lobby, 12,000 fresh flowers are refreshed weekly... not a single speck of dust resides on the grand staircase.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: My favorite indulgence is when the butler serves breakfast on the private balcony overlooking the Eiffel Tower. As the buttery croissant melts on your palate while Paris awakens... that exact moment makes you realize this is a place you must return to.

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: Precisely. And a note for our readers: booking through Expedia's official partner link ensures complimentary breakfast for two and prioritized VIP suite upgrades.

zh-tw.podcast_title: 第01集：是什麼讓巴黎喬治五世飯店值得每晚 2,000 美元？
zh-tw.soundscape_title: Symphonie de Marbre 與古典小提琴
zh-tw.soundscape_description: 悠揚的小提琴聲在大理石大廳間輕柔迴盪，與套房內 Bang & Olufsen 音響流淌出的 1950 年代法式爵士樂交織成迷人樂章。
zh-tw.gastronomy_title: 米其林三星 Le Cinq 的頂峰美饌與 5 萬瓶典藏酒窖
zh-tw.gastronomy_dish: 在私人陽台上細品裹夾 Isigny 奶油濃郁香氣的酥脆可頌，搭配主廚 Christian Le Squer 享譽盛名的法式焗烤洋蔥湯。
zh-tw.wine_pairing: Dom Pérignon 年份香檳，佐以地底 14 公尺深的百年歷史酒窖
zh-tw.positive_emotion: 沉浸於「靜謐權力」（Quiet Power）之中——超脫世俗喧囂，在巴黎心臟地帶盡享真正的皇家極致寵愛。
zh-tw.client_concern: 對巴黎都市喧囂的疑慮，在三重絕密隔音系統與完全避開人群的私密 VIP 通道中化為烏有。
zh-tw.target_persona: 商界領袖、政要名流，以及渴望在人生里程碑留下永恆奢華印記的浪漫情侶。
zh-tw.woa_declaration: 這絕對是此生必訪的殿堂——一個讓人每年都渴望重返、體會純正皇家尊榮的奢華庇護所！
zh-tw.victor_note: 當喬治五世大道的旋轉門緩緩轉動，由花藝大師 Jeff Leatham 精心設計的 12,000 朵鮮花香氣瞬間讓時間凝結。跟隨首席侍酒師 Eric Beaumard 深入地底 14 公尺、藏酒達 5 萬瓶的古老酒窖，這場體驗將再次提醒我們，為何法式優雅永遠無可匹敵。
zh-tw.lucky_note: 這裡最無價的隱藏驚喜：在清晨 6:45 醒來，拉開陽台套房沉甸甸的絲絨窗簾，凝望旭日金光灑落於艾菲爾鐵塔之巔。透過 Expedia 合作夥伴網絡預訂，將自動為您開啟尊榮房型升等特權，盡享無微不至的敬意與禮遇。
critique_positives: 頂級禮賓團隊與管家網路手握鑰匙，能為您解鎖博物館閉館期間的私人導覽
主廚 Christian Le Squer 掌舵的三星米其林美饌殿堂 Le Cinq
完美的隔音工藝——在繁華的巴黎金三角之上三層樓，享受極致靜謐
critique_considerations: 臨喬治五世大道的套房在時裝週期間可能會聽到護送車隊的鳴笛聲；若對聲音較為敏感，建議指定內庭大理石中庭方向的套房
私人陽台早餐服務需提前 45 分鐘預約，以便團隊精緻準備純銀餐盤與頂級亞麻餐巾

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: Victor，為什麼會有人願意花 2,000 美元只為在喬治五世飯店睡一晚？難道僅僅是因為皇家飯店的光環嗎？

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 並非如此，Lucky。在喬治五世，他們出售的不是一張舒適的床，而是上個世紀法國貴族的奢華體驗。當你踏入大廳，每週更換的 12,000 朵鮮花迎面而來……樓梯扶手上甚至找不到一顆塵埃。

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Lucky
podcast_dialogue.text: 而我最愛的，是管家將早餐端上能直面艾菲爾鐵塔的私人陽台那一刻。當金黃酥脆的可頌在口中融化，看著巴黎慢慢甦醒……那種震撼讓我由衷讚嘆，這是一個這輩子一定要再回來的地方！

podcast_dialogue.speaker: Victor
podcast_dialogue.text: 一點也沒錯。也提醒我們的讀者：透過 Expedia 官方合作夥伴連結預訂，即可確保享有雙人免費早餐以及優先 VIP 房型升等特權。
